# Read a comparison without hiding a regression

Original text walkthrough. Read one segment at a time and stop at each pause. The text below is the complete transcript and can be used as captions for your own recording. There is no required audio or video. A 5–10 minute reading-and-pause session is a provisional estimate, not a measured runtime.

## Segment 1 · Declare the unit

A document extractor is assessed on invoice ID and total. Source existence, correct fields, and supported missing-value handling are separate requirements.

**Pause before continuing:** Choose one deterministic check and one semantic check.

## Segment 2 · Keep paired cases visible

Two candidates each pass three of four supplied cases, but they fail different pages. An equal aggregate does not mean equal risk.

**Pause before continuing:** Draw a four-row comparison table and mark discordant cases.

## Segment 3 · Inspect the important failure

If one failure invents a total while another asks for review, their consequences differ. A predeclared hard gate can outweigh an average.

**Pause before continuing:** Write the release gate before deciding which candidate to keep.

## Segment 4 · Name the evidence limit

Synthetic practice and a tiny inspected set cannot establish future production performance. A fresh final set should be reserved before tuning.

**Pause before continuing:** Write one supported claim and one claim your evidence cannot justify.
